candidates.change_summary: Remove the proposalCount increment so proposalCount never increases on a new grant proposal.
Change the increment from 1 to 2 so each grant proposal bumps proposalCount by two.
Replace the increment with an assignment to 0 so proposalCount resets instead of increasing.
Delete the assignment 'VADER = _vader;' so VADER remains address(0) after init.
Assign msg.sender instead of _vader to VADER.
Assign _vader to USDV instead of _usdv, so USDV is set to the vader address.
Remove the statement assigning USDV so it remains address(0) after init.
Remove the assignment VAULT = _vault so VAULT stays address(0) after init.
Assign the VADER parameter to VAULT instead of the vault address.
Assign the USDV parameter to VAULT instead of the vault address.
Assign msg.sender to VAULT instead of the vault address parameter.
Remove the assignment so coolOffPeriod stays at its default value of 0.
